findings.claim: 10-K 列出競爭對手涵蓋線性電視、串流（含盜版）、遊戲、開放內容平台與社群媒體，並指新進入者可能以獨特服務進場。
findings.excerpt: New entrants may enter the market or existing providers may adjust their services with unique offerings or approaches to providing entertainment video.

findings.claim: Nielsen Gauge（2026年8月報導）：Netflix 占美國電視觀看 7.9%，去年同期 8.3%；YouTube 13.5%（12.8%）、Prime Video 4.2%（3.6%）、Peacock 2.3%（1.5%）。
findings.source: MediaPost, Streaming Climbs To 48.5%, Per Last Lame Duck Edition Of Nielsen's 'Gauge'
findings.excerpt: The latest edition shows streaming platform YouTube rising to a 13.5% share (vs. 12.8% a year ago), and Prime Video climbing to 4.2% (vs. 3.6%); Roku Channel to 3.0% (from 2.5%); and Peacock to 2.3% from 1.5%. Netflix sank to 7.9% from 8.3%.
